study_scope: Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 11. The historical province is a separate statistical return from Tibet and the other provinces. CHGIS supplies the dated prefectural hierarchy. Western administrative changes and exact population coverage are unquantified. No opening polygon is asserted.

Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 18. Use Cao's Gansu statistical scope. The table has separate retrospective Xinjiang and Qinghai rows, so their totals are excluded from this opening allocation. The 1911 administrative footprint has West Ningxia and Xining prefectures with their own documented scope and is not used as a 1900 population polygon.

Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 13. Remove the separately documented Cao Taiwan series from both endpoints, consistent with Federico–Tena China Workbook Sources note 11 and Appendix I pp. 72–73. Main-island Taiwan and the 1895 transfer are excluded from the opening leaf. The source does not itemize Penghu or foreign settlements. No opening polygon is asserted.
